ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: The diagram shows a food web with labels Sun, Algae, Small marine animals, Fish, and Humans. Arrows go from the Sun to Algae, from Algae to Small marine animals, from Small marine animals to Fish, and from Fish up to Humans in a boat. Reasoning: Following the arrows through the food web leads to the final consumer shown, labeled Humans. Therefore, the organism at the top of the food web is human.
